title: Characterization of valid configuration encodings
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $s$ be a nonnegative integer. A Boolean word $w$ satisfies the validity check for $N$, $x$, and $s$ if and only if there exists a configuration $C$ of $N$ on input $x$ such that every work-tape head lies within distance $s$ of the origin, every work tape is blank at positions whose distance from the origin exceeds $s$, and $w$ is the encoding of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
